quotes.text: Intune is not a VPN, not antivirus software, and not a remote desktop tool. It's a device management platform.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Clears up a common misconception about what Intune is.

quotes.text: Intune's answer to this is something called Mobile Application Management, or MAM for short. Instead of managing the whole device, Intune manages only the work apps.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Explains the core idea of MAM in two sentences.

quotes.text: Employees get to use their own devices. Employers get to protect their data. Nobody has to choose between privacy and security.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: A crisp statement of why app-level management makes BYOD workable.

quotes.text: The password was correct, the person was you. But the device wasn't healthy, so access was denied. This is the foundation of something called zero trust.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Illustrates how device health feeds Conditional Access and Zero Trust.

quotes.text: The best Intune deployment is the one users never think about. They just know their devices work, their apps are there, and their data is safe
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: A memorable success criterion for endpoint management.

chapters.title: From hand-built laptops to the cloud
The old way versus the Intune way
Identity, Conditional Access and Zero Trust

takeaways: Microsoft Intune is a cloud service that enrolls devices, enforces configuration and compliance policies, deploys apps and tracks device health across Windows, macOS, iOS, Android and some Linux devices.
Mobile Application Management protects work data inside apps like Outlook, Teams and OneDrive on personal phones, so IT can wipe corporate data without touching personal content.
Intune reports device health to Entra ID, where Conditional Access combines identity and device signals into Zero Trust access decisions.
hook: Managing laptops and phones by hand or through on-premises servers no longer works when people work from anywhere on their own devices. This episode is for IT beginners and decision-makers and explains how Intune enrolls and secures devices, protects data on personal phones and feeds Conditional Access for Zero Trust.
